sloka: तस्य अन्तरम् विदित्वा तु सहस्राक्षः शची पतिः ।मुनि वेष धरो भूत्वा अहल्याम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-४८-१८॥
transliteration: tasya antaram viditvā tu sahasrākṣaḥ śacī patiḥ ।muni veṣa dharo bhūtvā ahalyām idam abravīt ॥1-48-18॥

translations.english: 'O most beautiful one those overtaken by passion would not await the completion of the menstrual period (favourable for copulation). O woman of fine waist I desire union with you.'
